Description:

[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Re-textures the fairy trinket into a Kuro Maneki-Neko Fairy [b]ようせいのくろまねきねこ[/b] (妖精の黒招き猫) . The Maneki-Neko is the Japanese beckoning cat of most commonly fortune. The Black Maneki-Neko is the beckoning cat of protection from evil, misfortune, and negative influences, which I have added the fairy wings to. I may add more Maneki-Neko color variants for different trinkets at a later date if I feel like it and this actually works!! For example the White Calico and most well known version into a re-texture for the Parrot Egg. With the caveat that I have no idea how to modify or add audio files for the game... [/color]
